text: The subject is Tariq Nawaz, who holds account PK**MUCB****4062 opened on 6 July 2024. The subject declared an occupation of Student with a monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month. Between 2 April 2026 to 10 April 2026, the account recorded 17 credits totalling PKR 932,000 and 4 debits totalling PKR 875,000. The credits consisted of 17 interbank (IBFT) transfers received from 13 distinct senders. An alert was raised by Tazama on 10 April 2026, where Tazama typology MULE-01 scored 360 against an alert threshold of 300. The receipt of funds from 13 distinct senders is indicative of the money mule activity typology. Debits equal to 94% of credits, with a median of 4.5 hours between the latest credit and each debit, are consistent with rapid pass-through activity. The credits in the activity window were 37.3 times the declared monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month for a Student, which is inconsistent with the customer profile. Two sender banks raised fraud recall requests against inbound transfers to this account, citing scam complaints, as noted by Fraud Desk on 9 April 2026. The activity, involving 13 distinct senders and credits 37.3 times the declared monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month for a Student, is consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 642,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 3 transactions. PKR 233,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 1 transaction. There was no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening on 28 April 2026. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review by L2 analyst on 11 April 2026.
